title: Salsiccia Napolitana (Hot Italian Sausage)

items: Optional: 5 g food-grade polyphosphates per pound of meat

steps: Keep the meat cold. The source suggests freezing the cubed meat for about 10 minutes before grinding. Grind pork and fat separately through a 3/16-inch plate.
Dissolve the spices in ½ cup ice water. Add the wet spices and garlic to the ground meat and mix well. The source suggests optional food-grade polyphosphates.
Add the salt and mix for a couple of minutes, until tacky.
Stuff into well-rinsed 32–35 mm hog casings and refrigerate. The source says to eat within 5 days, or freeze.
